overall_verdict: S01 and S02 pass local QC, S04 is flagged for duplication and complexity warnings, S03 and S06 are excluded, S05 cannot be certified without RIN, and the retained design cannot support an interpretable treated-versus-control DE contrast as-is because batch and condition are perfectly confounded.
limitations: The inputs are explicitly synthetic teaching data; these are mechanical local-policy QC classifications, not new laboratory measurements or evidence of biological signal.

The retained set is limited to S01, S02, and S04, with control samples only in B1 and the treated sample only in B2; the retained-design hard_block prevents interpreting treatment effects separately from batch as-is.
S05 has no measured RIN in the input; no imputation was performed, so its quality remains uncertified rather than passing or failing on RIN.
S04 remains analyzable according to the assessor but requires review of duplication_rate=34.0% and nrf=0.71 before reliance on downstream results.

No DE model, raw-count/normalization checks, biological-replicate validation, statistical power analysis, effect-size estimation, multiple-testing correction, or paired-end layout validation was performed.
The overall confidence value follows the derived tier documented in CAPABILITIES.md and is not a calibrated probability of biological validity.

discrepancies.detail: Observed rationale/band tension: re-run returned rrna_rate=22.4% FAIL with pass<=10, warn<=15, while rationale calls >15% a strong warning. Returned FAIL governs. No status change; tool verdict governs per PLAN.
Separate protocol_consistency cut >20% appears in S06 re-run gate detail but not in metric grammar's 10%/15% cuts. Do not conflate or relax checks. No status change; tool verdict governs per PLAN.

Re-run returned QUARANTINED despite sole FAIL rrna_rate hardGate=false. Derived hard_gate_failure=false concerns metric gates, not lifecycle phase. PLAN preserves returned phase for non-hard-gate FAIL. No status change; exclude follows FAIL.

CAPABILITIES.md gap 1 and PLAN describe protocol consistency as reasoned/not tool-verified, but live assessor responses expose completeness and protocol-consistency gates. Gate records are observed software outputs; mechanistic explanations remain hypotheses, not assay validation. No status change.

unassessed_checks: DownstreamGate and the PreToolUse hook that blocks DE on non-ANALYSIS_READY samples: not exercisable with the available tools and not claimed as passed.
compbio multiple-testing-corrected gate: no DE analysis was run and no multiple-testing tool was available.
Paired-end library-layout check: layout is stated in BRIEF.md but no input field or tool validates it.
Confidence-tier caps beyond the documented derived-tier selection: no confidence-tier tool was available; per-sample confidence=1 values are tool outputs, not biological certainty.
DE statistical power, effect sizes, normalization/count-model suitability, and independent biological-replicate adequacy: outside the supplied QC and design checks.

provenance.serialization_conventions: Same shape retained: items is an array with unique id fields S01–S06, deliberately equivalent to PLAN sample-key wording. Raw per-sample gates use gate; synthesized study rollups use name. Consumers must distinguish schemas. overall aliases tool verdict; per_metric aliases tool results; missing_required and hard_gate_failure are derived.
provenance.revision_verification: All six exact-input QC re-runs, full-map compare_samples, both threshold tools, and full and mechanically retained check_batch_confound matched stored raw responses. Library counts derive from design.json, not verified biological independence. Confidence tier checked against CAPABILITIES.md only, not enforced or calibrated.
provenance.optional_metric_explanations: Optional PLAN Step 10 skipped; explain_qc_metric not called. Explanations come from assessor rationale strings. External attributions such as ENCODE/GTEx were not independently verified.
provenance.remediation_limit: S05 requires a measured RNA integrity assay record; generic tool FASTQ/BAM/aligner remediation does not supply measured RIN. Protocol-failure explanations are tool hypotheses, not assay diagnoses.
provenance.data_status: Synthetic teaching data, not measurements from any real study, as stated in inputs/qc_metrics.json and inputs/design.json.
provenance.intended_use: Pre-DE mechanical QC gate for the synthetic bulk poly(A)-selected RNA-seq design described in BRIEF.md.
provenance.unit_of_analysis: One bulk RNA-seq library/sample identifier (S01–S06); no cell-level, technical-replicate, or donor-level independence was inferred.
